note: CPW-run campground at the north entrance to Browns Canyon NM, 6 mi S of Buena Vista on CR-301; multi-level sites and a boat ramp on the Arkansas River. Single-lane gravel access narrows near the loop (fine for a 23-ft rig). --Claude
summary: Confirmed this is the Ruby Mountain loop (pin and site GPS agree) of CPW's AHRA listing. Confirmed $28 basic (2026-27, same in winter), year-round, reservation-only (fcfs never), 6-month window, 22 sites. Added 85-ft max/pull-through, no electric, reservable season year-round, deep link. Note: dropped 'Reservable Apr-Oct, FCFS in winter' (CPW: reservation only; a January night is bookable), the old 'Camp Colorado' name and field repeats. Facilities (vault toilets, no water) not stated by CPW; left.
flags: The AHRA's other campgrounds already have their own entries (2263 Hecla Junction, 2264 Rincon, 2266 Railroad Bridge, 2573 Salida East, 13963 Five Points, 13964 Point Barr, 13965 Vallie Bridge); this entry is Ruby Mountain itself. They share one cpwshop listing (parkID 50067), so a park-level read applies to all of them. Point Barr's 12 basic sites all list a 15-ft maximum vehicle length (criteria check for 13964 when it comes up).
state:CO policy row (fcfs never, 6-month window, vehicle pass $10/$15) matches what the AHRA pages say for this campground.
